Practised checking answers by estimating first.
Completed 4 estimation attempts; none were unaided correct.
Used rounding and addition/subtraction to discuss whether answers were reasonable.
Kabir mixed up rounding 869 to 4000 and remained unsure about estimated versus rounded answers.
Teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Kabir practised estimating numbers before checking an answer, including rounding and then adding or subtracting. They explained one football example correctly as 9 + 9 = 18. They mixed up the rounding of 869 and were still unsure about the words “estimated” and “rounded” at the end; this was not corrected after the last example. At home, ask them to round one number at a time to the nearest thousand and say whether the result is an estimate or the rounded number.
